CheckTitle: Storage account has soft delete for blobs enabled
Description: **Azure Storage accounts** have **blob soft delete** enabled via a retention policy that keeps deleted blobs for a set period.
Risk: Without this, blob deletions are permanent, reducing **availability** and **integrity**. A compromised user or faulty automation could erase blob data, forcing slow restores from backups and extending RTO/RPO, with potential downstream app outages.

Code.CLI: az storage blob service-properties delete-policy update --days-retained <retention-days> --account-name <example_resource_name> --enable true
Code.Other:
1. In the Azure portal, go to Storage accounts and open <storage account>
2. Under Data management, select Data protection
3. In the Blobs section, turn on Soft delete for blobs and set Retention (days) to a value (e.g., 7)
4. Click Save

Recommendation.Text: Enable **blob soft delete** and choose a retention window (`7-365` days) that meets your RPO. Pair with **container soft delete** and **versioning** for layered recovery. Enforce **least privilege** on delete actions and apply resource **locks** to prevent destructive changes.

Notes: Additional storage costs may be incurred as snapshots are retained.
